description: Chat scenarios with the expected guardrail result and router intent, for testing the guard (src/chat/guard_turn.py) and the router (CATALOG and AGENT_INTENT in src/chat/chat_service.py, docs/chat-intents.md). The expected values are what the rules in docs/chat-intents.md say should happen; an LLM can still pick differently, so a runner should report a mismatch rather than treat every case as exact.

fields.group: router | boundary | context | override | guard_off_topic | guard_harmful | injection
fields.context.chat: trip = the chat panel of an open trip with a plan (trip_id and plan_revision sent); discovery = /chat with no trip
fields.context.history: earlier turns, oldest first, as {role, content} plus optional metadata (an assistant card such as an open questionnaire)
fields.context.draft: conversation.request_draft before the message, or null
fields.expected.blocked: true when a guard stops the message before the router
fields.expected.category: off_topic | prompt_injection | harmful | null (denylist has no category)
fields.expected.agent: router agent: advice | web_lookup | discover | hotel_search | flight_search | create_trip | edit_plan | null when blocked or clarify
fields.expected.intent: messages.intent of the reply: advice | discover | booking_search | create_trip | edit_plan
fields.expected.metadata: keys the saved reply metadata must contain, or null when not checked
fields.note: why this is the expected result
